comment: T23 (B23) artifact size budget — docs/gui-seam.md §15. Ceilings are appendix T23's, in DECIMAL bytes (the appendix's 61,677,922-byte sidecar anchor reads 61.7 MB, so MB is decimal here). measuredBytes are ACTUALS from a release build on the machine/date recorded; null = honestly UNMEASURED (no builder for that platform/arch here — §15c registers each). Current measured governs; the anchors are recorded constants. Enforced by gui/src-tauri/tests/packaging.rs: schema + ceilings always; a re-stat of every artifact that exists locally — SYMMETRIC: measuredBytes and the on-disk size must be within 20% of each other in BOTH directions (an inflated baseline disarms the gate as surely as a grown artifact), and over-ceiling fails. A measured row whose path is missing while its artifact ROOT exists (src-tauri/target/release/bundle; src-tauri/binaries for the sidecar) FAILS as STALE — the paths carry the version string, so a version bump orphans a row by construction, and libtest swallows stdout on pass, so there is no loud-skip channel (B23 round-1 H1); only a fresh clone with no root at all skips, and null rows are ceiling-only. T24's CI, which builds every artifact, re-measures and is the release-time enforcer. An .app row is the sum of regular-file bytes in its tree; file artifacts are their file size.
